text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan's economic adviser Andre Azoulay tells seminar on EU fisheries industries partnership the sector's added value should be fairly split.
- Candidates for local councils elections due on June 13 total 39,563 to May 25.
- King Hassan congratulates new Iranian President Mohammad Khatami over elections victory.
- Visiting Libyan envoy Khoueldi Hamidi says he bears important message for King Hassan from Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi
- European Fisheries Commissioner Emma Bonino says she does not doubt the fact Morocco's fish resources are dwindling.
- Moroccan and European fisheries operators intensify contacts during seminar on fish industries partnership.
